name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: ☠ Record a dead-out by voice: Bee Yard Wingman asks what you saw, one thing at a time, then the cause, and reads it back. No tapping.
🎙️ Voice control knows more treatments and feeds: sprayed oxalic acid, powdered sugar, drone brood removal, brood break, Fumagilin, ProSweet, pollen patty, fondant and candy board.
🎙️ Say "save" on its own while talking to save. "Pollen coming in" and frame counts no longer set the stores levels.
☠ "Is the colony dead, or is it gone?" A dead colony and one that left are recorded differently.
🐝 Buddy talks more smoothly, says more himself (about 130 new lines), and says Apivar, ApiLife, Api-Bioxal, nosema, Tylan and amitraz properly.
👂 The "your turn" tick waits until the phone is really listening, so your first word isn't lost. Many more misheard words understood.
✂️ Splits by voice: "We're going to split hive 4" starts one, and "Hive five" counts as Hive 5.
💊 Buddy says Mite Away Quick Strips back if that's what you said (saved as MAQS). One pound, two pounds.
